panels.title: Total Tokens Saved
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted).

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(tokens_saved) FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}')

panels.title: Total Cost Saved (USD)
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted). Cost saved includes the estimated input cost a cache hit avoided.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost_saved_usd), 2) FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}')

panels.title: Avg Saving %
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN baseline_tokens = 0 THEN 0 ELSE tokens_saved * 100.0 / baseline_tokens END)::numeric, 1) FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}')

panels.title: Total Calls
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}')

panels.title: Unique Users
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(user_id, '')) FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}')

panels.title: Tokens Saved per $granularity
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('${granularity}', timestamp) AS time, SUM(tokens_saved) AS tokens_saved FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Call Volume per User
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('${granularity}', timestamp) AS time, user_id AS metric, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Savings by G-Group
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted). Only groups that saved tokens are listed: one that added tokens (e.g. retrieval context) is left out, though the request totals still count it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT key AS group, SUM(value::int) AS total_saved FROM usage_events, jsonb_each_text(group_savings) WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_saved DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Cost Saved per User (USD)
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted). Cost saved includes the estimated input cost a cache hit avoided.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('${granularity}', timestamp) AS time, user_id AS metric, ROUND(SUM(cost_saved_usd), 4) AS cost_saved FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Period-over-Period Comparison
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted). Cost saved includes the estimated input cost a cache hit avoided.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('${granularity}', timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS period, SUM(tokens_saved) AS tokens_saved, ROUND(SUM(cost_saved_usd), 2) AS cost_saved FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(timestamp)

panels.title: Model Tier Distribution
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted).

targets.rawSql: SELECT routed_model AS model, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Savings by User
panels.description: From usage_events: billable requests (an admin acting as a tenant, and error rows, are not counted). Cost saved includes the estimated input cost a cache hit avoided.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('${granularity}', timestamp) AS period, user_id, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(tokens_saved) AS tokens_saved, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN baseline_tokens = 0 THEN 0 ELSE tokens_saved * 100.0 / baseline_tokens END)::numeric, 1) AS avg_pct_saving, ROUND(SUM(cost_saved_usd), 4) AS cost_saved_usd FROM usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND COALESCE(billable, true) AND ('${tenant}' = '.*' OR tenant_id = '${tenant}') AND ('${user_id}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${user_id}') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1 DESC, tokens_saved DESC

list.name: user_id
list.label: User
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM usage_events WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year' AND user_id <> '' ORDER BY 1
